_comment: One factory calls `new` for two callers, the service at one call site and plain data at the other; the plain instance is compared structurally, the service reads one method. Under the class rule (a service that reaches class code bails its key; class code is every class body that is not a key class, and every function nested in one) the constructor's parameter holds the service, so every method stays, including the unread one, and the bundle runs.
